name: Horseless Carriage

rounds.endCondition: Game ends in phase 6 once the timecard marker has been turned over, or in year 7 when no factory floor expansion could be placed in phase 3

categories.label: Wealth (wealth accumulation track)
categories.hint: Total dollars scored from car sales in phase 5: price marker of the price segment per car, +$1 per truck, +$2 per sports car. Record the final track value.

categories.label: Sales focus position (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Vị trí Sales focus (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Higher position on the engineering/sales focus track wins ties; enter the focus-track value (higher = more sales focus).

tiebreakers.description: Among tied players, the one with the highest sales focus wins

notes: family: running-track. Wealth is accumulated only from car sales during phase 5 each year; no end-game bonus is stated in the rulebook text consulted. The official PDF (cardboardappendix mirror) is image-only/corrupt for text extraction here, so rules were read from the Cardboard Appendix transcription of the official rulebook and cross-checked with RulesPal; hence not marked high. 2nd edition clarifications not separately verified.
